description_html:
The SMOK TFV18 Meshed Coil is a replacement coil for compatible SMOK devices.

  • Product Type: Replacement Coil
  • Coil Resistance: Dual Mesh 0.15Ω / Mesh 0.33Ω
  • Coil Material: Mesh
  • Compatible Devices: SMOK TFV18 Tank, TFV16 Tank, Mag-18 Kit
  • Pack Quantity: 3 Coils
  • Brand: SMOK

Coils are consumable - replace when flavour or vapour output drops.

Available options: Smok TFV18 Meshed 0.33ohm Coils 3/PK, Smok TFV18 Dual Meshed 0.15ohm Coils 3/PK.
